title: Actuarial Computation Sheet: Loan Interest Capitalized at a Whole Life Insurance Policy Anniversary
content:
Loan interest capitalized on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy is fixed at the policy anniversary that closes the interest period.

## Formal statement

1. **When interest is capitalized.** Loan interest for the interest period that a policy anniversary closes is billed on that anniversary. Where the owner has not paid it within **31 calendar days** after the anniversary, it is capitalized: added to the loan principal as a single capitalization entry dated that anniversary, the capitalized amount bearing interest from the anniversary like the rest of the principal.
2. **Principal.** The loan principal as the policy ledger totals it: the loan advances and the capitalized interest on the ledger, less the principal repaid (the amounts on the loan repayment entries) and the principal extinguished (the amounts on the loan offset entries).
3. **Rate.** The tier's loan interest rate, simple.
4. **Time.** The actual calendar days from the loan interest paid-to date shown on the policy to the anniversary, over **365**.
5. **Interest capitalized.** The ledger principal multiplied by the rate and by that number of days over 365, rounded half up to the cent.

## Quantities and their records

| Quantity | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Anniversary | The policy anniversary that closes the interest period |
| Loan advances, capitalized interest, principal repaid, principal extinguished | The loan advance, capitalization, loan repayment and loan offset entries on the policy's activity history |
| Loan interest paid-to date | The policy record |
| Loan interest rate | The tier's loan terms |

## Worked computation (hypothetical policy, loan interest rate 6%)

Ledger: loan advances of 10000.00 and 2000.00, one capitalization entry of 600.00, a repayment of 1500.00, no offset. Ledger principal: 10000.00 plus 2000.00 plus 600.00 less 1500.00, that is 11100.00.

| Loan interest paid-to date | Anniversary | Days | Interest capitalized |
|---|---|---|---|
| June 1, 2024 | June 1, 2025 | 365 | 11100.00 times 0.06 times 365 over 365: 666.00 |
| Same principal, 200 days | | 200 | 11100.00 times 0.06 times 200 over 365: 364.9315, rounded to 364.93 |

## Billing window (hypothetical anniversary of March 10)

Interest paid by April 10, the 31st calendar day after the anniversary, is not capitalized. Interest still unpaid after April 10 is capitalized in one entry dated March 10.
